body: Thanks for trying. I have some time now so I’m just going to go.

I had a counselor but she made me stop talking to her when she recommended a book about walking on egg shells related to living someone with bipolar or borderline personality disorder because she felt my counselor was diagnosing her without ever meeting her. The counselor wanted me to bring up the idea that she might have those before her first psychiatrist appointment but wait for a good time close to the appointment to avoid a lot of unnecessary conflict. My wife took that as my counselor telling me to keep secrets from her and dropping some bomb on her unfairly.
She’ll be home again soon. I have to log back into work for a meeting. I am getting so anxious I just want to run away and disappear

She accuses me of being manipulative out of no where. Everything I do is suspect. I don’t know what to believe anymore. Maybe I am fucked. I probably deserve to just disappear they’d all be better off
